mapper.select: SELECT g.id FROM family_groups g WHERE g.created_at < #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM family_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.family_group_id = g.id AND u.line_user_id NOT LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')) ORDER BY g.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM expense_records WHERE family_group_id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM payment_accounts WHERE family_group_id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM family_members WHERE family_group_id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM family_groups WHERE id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM users WHERE line_user_id LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND created_at < #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM family_members m WHERE m.user_id = users.id)
